snippet.title: DKC4 - Starblast Speedway
snippet.description:
This was a level created for the second Speedrun event of the DKC4 community, in the final version it has a Timer that measures the Run time. The entire theme and level design was developed by me, trying to mix some barrel shooting mechanics into a completely vertical level.

Level Design and Concept: @Rangelukaz.

DKC4 Engine: Kalango, Leocore, Necrotoad.

Custom Animal Tokens 3D Models: Vege, Jeffery Bones

Kongs and Animal Tokens Custom Sprites: Molly Snyder (Phyreburnz).

Music: Rodrigo Boechat - Star and Clouds.
#donkeykongcountry #donkeykong #fangame #snes
